commands.short: List positions by account and security, or totals per security
commands.example:
fui position list --account Broker --date 2026-03-31 --json
  fui position list --by-security --csv

flags.name: by-security
flags.usage: total each security across all accounts, valued in the base currency

flags.name: date
flags.usage: compute positions as of this date (default: today)
